items.title: 68251_Teddy McRae oral history interview
items.q: but not as flashy as Mike Lucky. Lucky would go way out, you know. Jump off the piano and jump down and do a split

ctx.x: Like a stand-up in front of the band.

All right, like a Lucky Millinder. He was flashy like Lucky Millinder, but not as flashy as Mike Lucky. Lucky would go way out, you know. Jump off the piano and jump down and do a split -- all that kind of stuff -- with his tails on. Bardu Ali could do a split, turn over, and do all the things like Lucky. He knew the tempos of the band. He looked good in front of the band. He was a nice looking man -- very nice
